meta.name: openspec-archive-change
meta.description: Archive a completed change in the experimental workflow. Use when the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 归档已完成变更，收尾实验工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用实验性流程管理开发变更，需要归档已完成的改动。
copy.tagline_en: Archive completed changes and wrap up experimental workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage development changes with an experimental workflow and need to archive completed ones.

howto.what: 用户要求归档已完成变更时,Claude 会先让用户选择变更(若未指定),检查其完成度与规格同步状态,然后移动到归档文件夹并显示摘要。
howto.when: 当用户想要在实现完成后最终确定并归档一个变更时触发。

say.text: 帮我归档刚才完成的那个变更
say.note: Claude 会列出待归档变更让你确认。
Claude 会检查完成状态并移动归档。

say.text: 归档变更 A,并同步规格
say.note: Claude 会先评估同步再归档。

howto.what_en: When asked to archive a completed change, Claude prompts for the change if unnamed, checks completion and spec sync state, moves it to the archive folder, and shows a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete.

say_en.text: Help me archive the change I just finished.
say_en.note: Claude will list active changes for you to pick.
Claude checks completion and archives it.

say_en.text: Archive change A and sync its specs.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates sync first, then archives.
